entries.description: Managed Model Context Protocol server for SurrealDB Cloud. Deploy and manage instances and contexts, run SurrealQL against cloud instances, manage organisation access and billing, and connect agent memory - from any MCP-compatible client.
representativeQueries: deploy a new SurrealDB Cloud instance
run a SurrealQL query against my cloud database
list my SurrealDB Cloud organisations and instances
check the status, metrics, and logs of my SurrealDB instance

entries.description: A2A Agent Card for the SurrealDB Cloud MCP server: the skills it offers, the interface it is reachable on, and both authentication paths - Surreal ID OAuth and a personal access token. The service speaks MCP rather than an A2A transport binding, so a client finding no supported binding should connect over MCP.
representativeQueries: what can the SurrealDB agent do
how do I authenticate an agent with SurrealDB

entries.description: Curated llms.txt overview of the SurrealDB platform - the multi-model database engine, agent memory layer, distributed storage, SurrealDB Cloud, and SurrealDB Studio - with links to canonical pages. Every page on the site also supports markdown content negotiation via 'Accept: text/markdown' or a '.md' path suffix.
representativeQueries: what is SurrealDB and what can it do
give me an overview of the SurrealDB platform and its products
how does SurrealDB support AI agents, vector search, and graph queries

entries.description: Expanded llms.txt corpus with the full text of the SurrealDB website for deep context loading.
representativeQueries: load the full SurrealDB website content as context
explain SurrealQL and SurrealDB features in depth
detailed reference on SurrealDB products, features, and use cases

entries.description: Agent Skills discovery index for SurrealDB, listing every published SKILL.md with a sha256 digest over the bytes served alongside it. Covers the CLI, the JavaScript and Python SDKs, SurrealKit, SurrealQL with its functions and query performance, and vector search.
representativeQueries: how do I write SurrealQL
how do I connect to SurrealDB from Python

entries.description: OpenAPI 3.0 description of the SurrealDB API Server at api.surrealdb.com, covering the public platform endpoints for SurrealDB Cloud.

manage SurrealDB Cloud resources over HTTP
get the OpenAPI schema for api.surrealdb.com

entries.description: RFC 9727 api-catalog linkset enumerating SurrealDB API surfaces, their documentation, OpenAPI descriptions, and status pages.

entries.description: How an agent obtains and uses a credential for SurrealDB: Surreal ID OAuth with dynamic client registration for interactive clients, and personal access tokens for unattended ones, with the scopes each surface needs.
representativeQueries: how does an agent sign in to SurrealDB
how do I create a SurrealDB personal access token
